Only proven-lost, uninstalled objective can reserve one paid replacement; no second active instance or quote.
Replacement advances instance generation of the same objective, never mints another objective or resets completed progress.
Single-install tombstone and interrupted-lift owner prevent duplicate installed/cargo copies or repeat rewards.
Restored worksite, actual input bill and manual route must remain attainable without the missing module/truck.
Existing saves keep their actual identity and custody through explicit migration; forward choice is not claimed as a source fact.
